summary: Miami is a vibrant tropical metropolis where Art Deco architecture meets modern luxury, Latin culture pulses through its diverse neighborhoods, and pristine beaches provide endless entertainment. From the colorful streets of Wynwood to the upscale shopping of South Beach, Miami offers world-class dining, water sports, and cultural experiences year-round. The city's unique blend of Caribbean, Cuban, and American influences creates an intoxicating energy that captivates visitors.

restaurants.name: El Vecino
restaurants.description: Authentic Cuban sandwich shop serving traditional Cuban breakfast and lunch items in a no-frills atmosphere. A local favorite for decades with lines out the door during peak hours.

restaurants.name: Juvia
restaurants.description: Upscale Pan-Latin restaurant in Wynwood featuring innovative cuisine that blends Peruvian, African, and Asian influences. The rooftop bar offers craft cocktails with panoramic city views.

restaurants.name: Versailles Restaurant
restaurants.description: Miami's most iconic Cuban restaurant in Little Havana, serving generations of families with traditional ropa vieja, mofongo, and authentic Cuban coffee. The window counter is perfect for quick, authentic dining.
restaurants.mustTry: Ropa vieja with black beans and rice

restaurants.name: Casa Tua
restaurants.description: Romantic fine dining establishment housed in a historic mansion in Coral Gables serving contemporary Mediterranean cuisine. Intimate garden setting with candlelit tables creates an unforgettable evening.

restaurants.name: Wynwood Walls Café & Bistro
restaurants.description: Casual bistro located adjacent to Wynwood's famous street art murals serving fresh salads, sandwiches, and Latin fusion fare. Perfect spot for lunch while exploring the arts district.

restaurants.name: Stubborn Seed
restaurants.description: Chef Jeremy Ford's innovative Southern-influenced American cuisine in a sophisticated downtown setting. Award-winning restaurant featuring seasonal ingredients and creative cocktails.

restaurants.name: Enriqueta's Sandwich Shop
restaurants.description: Legendary hole-in-the-wall sandwich shop in Buena Vista open since 1927, serving massive Cuban sandwiches and fresh juices. Local institution with authentic charm and incredible value.

restaurants.name: Garcia's Seafood Grille & Fish Market
restaurants.description: Waterfront seafood spot on the Miami River offering fresh daily catches grilled to perfection with river views. Popular with both locals and tourists for authentic Miami seafood experience.

restaurants.name: Macchialina
restaurants.description: Intimate Italian restaurant in South Beach with only 30 seats offering seasonal tasting menus and extensive wine selection. Reservations essential for this chef-driven culinary experience.

restaurants.name: The Salty Donut
restaurants.description: Wildly popular gourmet donut shop with creative flavor combinations and locally roasted coffee. Line forms early as flavors change daily and sell out quickly.

restaurants.name: Juvia
restaurants.description: Stunning Wynwood restaurant celebrating Pan-Latin cuisine with influences from Peru, Africa, and Asia in a colorfully designed space. Rooftop bar and lounge with craft cocktails and city views.
restaurants.mustTry: Black miso marinated Chilean sea bass

restaurants.name: Andres Club
restaurants.description: Contemporary Latin American restaurant in Brickell offering ceviche, grilled meats, and tropical cocktails in a lively atmosphere. Great for casual lunch or dinner with friends.

activities.name: South Beach Swimming and People Watching
activities.description: Iconic Miami Beach featuring pristine sand, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and the famous Art Deco lifeguard towers. Perfect for swimming, sunbathing, and observing the diverse Miami crowd.

activities.name: Wynwood Walls Street Art Tour
activities.description: Self-guided or organized walking tour through Miami's most vibrant street art district with murals from international artists. Free to explore though paid guided tours available for deeper insights.

activities.name: Biscayne Bay Boat Tour and Snorkeling
activities.description: Full-day or half-day boat excursion exploring coral reefs, shipwrecks, and marine life with snorkeling opportunities. Encounter colorful tropical fish, sea turtles, and manatees in their natural habitat.

activities.name: Art Deco Historic District Walking Tour
activities.description: Guided or self-guided exploration of Miami Beach's largest collection of Art Deco architecture built in the 1920s-1940s. Admire pastel-colored buildings, intricate details, and learn about Miami's history.

activities.name: Little Havana Cuban Culture Experience
activities.description: Immerse yourself in authentic Cuban culture through street art, cigar shops, cafés, and local markets. Walk Calle Ocho, enjoy Cuban coffee, watch domino games, and experience Miami's Cuban heritage.

activities.name: Everglades National Park Airboat Tour
activities.description: Thrilling high-speed airboat ride through the famous Florida Everglades spotting alligators, manatees, and native birds. Professional guides share wildlife knowledge while navigating shallow marshlands.

activities.name: Pérez Art Museum Miami
activities.description: World-class contemporary art museum in downtown Miami featuring international artists and innovative installations. Stunning architecture overlooking Biscayne Bay with rotating exhibitions.

activities.name: Coral Gables Historic Neighborhood Exploration
activities.description: Picturesque planned community featuring Mediterranean Revival architecture, prestigious hotels, and luxury shopping. Walk tree-lined streets, visit the historic Biltmore Hotel, and enjoy upscale dining.

activities.name: Water Sports: Paddleboarding and Kayaking
activities.description: Rent paddleboards or kayaks to explore Miami's waterways, mangrove forests, and coastal areas at your own pace. Suitable for all skill levels with rental shops throughout the city.

activities.name: Vizcaya Museum and Gardens
activities.description: Stunning Italian Renaissance-style mansion with meticulously manicured gardens overlooking Biscayne Bay. Historic home offers architectural tours and hosts cultural events and exhibitions.

activities.name: Miami Nightlife: Clubs and Bars
activities.description: Experience world-famous nightclubs, rooftop bars, and beachfront venues in South Beach and downtown. World-renowned DJs, craft cocktails, and vibrant energy make Miami a premier nightlife destination.

activities.name: Free Walking Tour of Miami's Neighborhoods
activities.description: Tip-based walking tours exploring diverse Miami neighborhoods including Wynwood, Buena Vista, and downtown. Learn local history, architecture, street art, and community stories from knowledgeable guides.

spots.name: South Beach Art Deco Historic District
spots.description: Pastel-colored 1920s-1940s buildings with geometric patterns, neon signs, and vintage cars create iconic Miami imagery.
spots.bestTime: Golden hour morning or evening light

spots.name: Wynwood Walls
spots.description: Vibrant street art murals covering entire buildings with bold colors, intricate designs, and constantly changing contemporary art.
spots.bestTime: Midday for saturated colors, golden hour for dimension

spots.name: Biscayne Bay Sunrise from South Pointe Park
spots.description: Dramatic water reflections with Miami skyline backdrop and historic jetty creating layered compositional elements.

spots.name: Vizcaya Museum Gardens
spots.description: Renaissance-inspired manicured gardens with fountains, sculptures, and architectural details against tropical foliage.
spots.bestTime: Early morning or late afternoon for soft light

spots.name: Little Havana Calle Ocho
spots.description: Colorful street life featuring Cuban storefronts, murals, street musicians, and authentic cultural scenes.

spots.name: Downtown Miami River at Dusk
spots.description: Modern skyline reflecting in the Miami River with bridges, boats, and architectural lights creating urban landscape drama.

spots.name: Coral Gables Mediterranean Architecture
spots.description: Spanish colonial revival buildings, tree-lined streets, fountains, and historic landmarks in meticulously preserved neighborhood.

spots.name: Oleta River State Park Mangroves
spots.description: Tangled mangrove roots, tropical vegetation, and waterway reflections creating natural layered textures and wildlife opportunities.
spots.bestTime: Early morning for wildlife and light

spots.name: South Beach Lifeguard Towers at Sunrise
spots.description: Iconic Art Deco lifeguard towers painted in pastel colors silhouetted against dawn sky and ocean waves.

spots.name: Wynwood Neighborhood Night Neon Signs
spots.description: Neon signs, street lights reflecting off wet streets, and vibrant storefronts creating moody urban night photography.
spots.bestTime: Night after 8pm with rain or wet surfaces

sunriseSpots: Miami Beach Lifeguard Tower at 14th Street
sunsetSpots: Key Biscayne Lighthouse at Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park
lensRecommendations: 16-35mm wide-angle for architecture and street scenes capturing entire storefronts and landscapes
50mm prime for intimate street portraits and detail work in Little Havana cultural photography
70-200mm telephoto for wildlife in Everglades and mangroves, compressed compositions of cityscape
Macro lens for detail shots of Art Deco architectural elements, flowers, and street art textures
photography.goldenHourNotes: Miami's golden hour is exceptionally photogenic from 6-7am at sunrise when pastel Art Deco buildings glow and the ocean is glass-like, and 6:30-7:30pm at sunset when downtown skyline reflects in the Miami River. The tropical light is intense, so shoot in RAW and expose for highlights. Cloud formations create dramatic skies year-round, particularly during afternoon summer thunderstorms.

weather.seasonality: Miami's dry season from November through April offers pleasant temperatures (20-25°C), minimal rainfall, and perfect beach conditions. The summer season May-October brings hot, humid weather (28-30°C) with daily afternoon thunderstorms and higher hurricane risk, though storms are usually brief.
weather.summary: Miami enjoys a tropical climate with warm waters year-round suitable for beach activities. Dry, mild winters from November-April make this the prime tourist season, while summer brings intense heat, humidity, and frequent afternoon thunderstorms.

hotels.name: South Pointe Hotel
hotels.description: Oceanfront budget-friendly hotel with basic clean rooms, small pool, and direct beach access on South Pointe in Miami Beach.

hotels.name: Kimpton Hotel Palomar Miami Beach
hotels.description: Stylish contemporary hotel in South Beach featuring modern design, rooftop pool, excellent restaurant, and pet-friendly amenities.

hotels.name: The Biltmore Hotel Coral Gables
hotels.description: Historic 1926 Renaissance Revival palace featuring opulent rooms, championship golf course, world-class spa, and fine dining experiences.
